theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_elc2_averaged_hessian
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (Ψ : (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) → ℝ) (lam ε MB LB H α : ℝ) (S : Set (Rn n)) (P₀ P₁ : Rn n → Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), ContDiff ℝ 2 Ψ → 0 ≤ LB → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖Q‖ ^ 2 ≤ fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q) → (∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q'| ≤ MB * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖) → (∀ P P' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, ‖P‖ ≤ ε → ‖P'‖ ≤ ε → ∀ Q Q' : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P Q Q' - fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) P' Q Q'| ≤ LB * ‖P - P'‖ * ‖Q‖ * ‖Q'‖) → (∀ x ∈ S, ‖P₀ x‖ ≤ ε) → (∀ x ∈ S, ‖P₁ x‖ ≤ ε) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖P₀ x - P₀ y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ‖P₁ x - P₁ y‖ ≤ H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α) → ∃ a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ, (∀ (x : Rn n) (P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ), a x P Q = ∫ t in (0 : ℝ)..1, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ Ψ) (P₀ x + t • (P₁ x - P₀ x)) P Q) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ P : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, lam * ‖P‖ ^ 2 ≤ a x P P) ∧ (∀ x ∈ S, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q| ≤ MB * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖) ∧ ∀ x ∈ S, ∀ y ∈ S, ∀ P Q : Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ, |a x P Q - a y P Q| ≤ LB * H * ‖x - y‖ ^ α * ‖P‖ * ‖Q‖
